Our Mission
Attendi has already built a strong user base through speech-to-text integrations with electronic health record (EHR) vendors, used by over 350 care organisations in elderly and disability care. Every month, more than 1 million reports are created with Attendi. With the Attendi App, we are building a one-stop solution for AI-driven administration in healthcare: structured documentation, conversation summaries, voice-driven workflows and AI assistance, anytime, anywhere.

We see our output being used to support decisions in care. That’s why we are certifying the Attendi App as a medical device under MDR (Class IIa). Our first certificate, for recording conversations and generating summaries, is expected in Q1 2027. Next, we move towards decision support: dynamic care plans that update based on daily reports, with proactive suggestions for care professionals. We move fast and release often, with the user at the centre, and we do it in a compliant way.

Until now, quality and compliance has been spread across the company. To deliver MDR features continuously, we need a dedicated Quality & Compliance team. You will set it up.

Your Role
As Head of Quality & Compliance at Attendi, you will:

• Set up and lead a new Quality & Compliance team: define the frameworks, the way of working and who is responsible for what.

• Bring cadence and focus: a clear planning, weekly priorities and a steady rhythm in delivering our MDR roadmap.

• Act as PRRC (Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance) under MDR.

• Own our quality management system and keep us audit-ready for MDR, ISO 27001 and NEN 7510.

• Pick up compliance questions yourself, and train the team so they can do the same.

• Work closely with our Compliance Officer, Clinical Product Owner and product and development teams.

• Grow the team, starting with bringing clinical evaluation in-house.

• Manage external partners, such as our ISO partner and clinical writing consultancy, and be a point of contact for our notified body.

• Be part of our management team, reporting to both founders.

You might be a good fit if you hit most or all of the following:

• Experience in a quality, regulatory or compliance role at a Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) company.

• Hands-on MDR experience, and you can take on the PRRC role.

• Leadership experience: you’ve managed a team, and ideally helped set one up or grow it.

• Experience at a company that has already gone through this journey, but not at a large corporate scale.

• You love structure, precision and planning, and you make tough choices when needed.

• High ownership: you’re comfortable walking in where the frameworks don’t exist yet, and setting them.

• When knowledge is missing in your team, you make sure it’s brought in.

• Fluent in English

Strong candidates may also

• Have built a quality or regulatory function from scratch before.

• Have experience with ISO 27001, NEN 7510 or the AI Act.

• Have worked with AI products.

What we offer

• Salary between €7,000 and €9,000 per month (excl HA).

• A seat in the management team of a profitable, fast-growing scale-up.

• Hybrid working: roughly half the week at home, half at our Amsterdam office.

• Travel and lunch allowance.

• Home office budget.

• Lease bike.

• Training budget of €1,500 per year.

• Company MacBook.

• ClassPass membership.

• Pension contribution of 10% and roughly 7% paid by Attendi.

A certificate of conduct (VOG) is required for this position.

Our culture: People-oriented, curious, and proactive
At Attendi, you’ll work in a small, ambitious team that learns and builds together. We are empathetic, take initiative, dare to experiment, and stand by our work. Making mistakes is okay as long as you learn from them.

description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.  

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock , TPG (The Rise Fund) , SoftBank, Glynn Capital , NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

Our Partnership Program is a key initiative for the company. The Partner Account Manager’s primary duty is to engage, build and develop Human Interest’s key accounts and growth opportunities. We're looking for a forward-thinking, meticulously organized, and self-motivated sales professional who can thrive in a fast-paced environment.  You'll accelerate our partner relationships to help us exponentially reach more small and medium businesses across the United States, which is essential to our growth.
